data.body: debug-everything 2026-05-08: Classification: llm-behavioral (REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md is a markdown file in plugins/dso/docs/workflows/, ticket signal references orchestrator behavior drift). Applied targeted fix per reporter's suggestion #2: added MANDATORY OVERLAY BREADCRUMB requirement at Step 4 dispatch with mandatory format 'OVERLAYS_DISPATCHED: security=Y/N performance=Y/N test_quality=Y/N'. The breadcrumb makes missed overlays observable. Note: this is a behavioral guidance fix; full enforcement requires either the schema-fail-closed parser (suggestion #3) or fixturing (suggestion #1). Reporter suggestions #1 and #3 remain valid follow-ups but require larger scope (test infrastructure / parser refactor).
